name: Black Hole DSP2
source: Erica Synths Black Hole DSP II user manual via https://cn.juno.co.uk/downloads/manual/690950-01U.pdf/ ; https://www.ericasynths.lv/shop/eurorack-modules/by-series/black-series/black-hole-dsp2; ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026)
notes: No local manual; manual text was only readable in garbled form, panel image not seen. IN L is normalled to IN R. PATCH CV selects the effect; PARAM 1-3 CV inputs pair with the three parameter knobs; CRUSH CV (sample-rate/DSP clock CV) has an attenuator knob; DRY/WET CV modulates the analogue mix. Exact printed wording of the PARAM CV and DRY/WET jack labels unconfirmed. No clock/tap input found.
